title: Grateful Dead Live at Onondaga County War Memorial on 1971-10-27

ai_review.summary: Mono soundboard captures a high‑energy New York show with a standout 'Comes a Time' and solid Keith keyboards, but the lack of stereo limits the listening experience.
ai_review.review: The performance is described as rock‑inspired and commandingly tight, highlighted by a heartfelt reading of "Comes a Time" where Jerry Garcia shines. The recording is monophonic soundboard tape that sounds good overall, though reviewers wish it were in stereo.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is praised with high energy and notable performances; recording quality is decent but limited to mono, leading to an overall rating just above four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Monophonic (mono) board tape; clear and enjoyable but lacking stereo depth. Reviewers note desire for a stereo mix and mention possible tweaking with software.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid, rock‑heavy set that stays in command throughout; good transitions and overall momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry nails his solo on 'Comes a Time' and leads the band strongly.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's keyboard work is praised as sounding great throughout the show.
